spanish: Sobre tortas de pan de levadura acercará su ofrenda, sobre sacrificio: agradecimiento de sus ofrendas de paz.
grammarChanges: Changed 'pan leudado' to 'pan de levadura': לֶחֶם (construct) + חָמֵץ (absolute) is 'bread of leaven' (noun governing noun), not 'leavened bread'; the adjective form dropped חָמֵץ as its own referent.

Changed 'sacrificio de agradecimiento' to 'sacrificio: agradecimiento' (punctuation only, no words added or reordered beyond the colon): זֶבַח is absolute, not construct, so it cannot be the head of a 'de'-genitive over the thanksgiving phrase that follows; the colon marks apposition instead of possession.
Changed 'sus pazes' to 'sus ofrendas de paz': שְׁלָמָיו is plural construct + 3ms suffix ('his peace-offerings'); 'pazes' only partly carries the offering sense that H8002 requires.
readerNote: Chose a colon (apposition) over 'de' between sacrificio and agradecimiento because זֶבַח is absolute, not construct, so it cannot grammatically govern the thanksgiving phrase as a genitive.
